verses.1: But when Gideon trusted in the Lord, he conquered the army of Judah, and he destroyed armies that had no number, like locusts and swarming armies.
verses.2: Do not trust in foreign gods, for there is no other god except me, O kings and princes.
verses.3: For I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the womb of your mother, and who followed after you, and sustained you, and strengthened you. Why then do you trust in and worship another god besides me?
verses.4: And all this I have done for you, and what have you given me? And what do I ask of you, except the salvation of your souls, that you should walk in my law and in my ordinances and in my commandments? And I also will give you the salvation of your souls.
verses.5: The Lord, who rules over all, says: Save yourselves from idols and from error and from deception.
verses.6: For the wrath of the Lord will come upon those who do this, and upon those who obey them, and upon those who do their will, and upon those who associate with them, and upon those who walk in their commandments.
verses.7: For peoples who do not know you and who do not resemble you will rise up against you, and they will devour the fruit of your toil, if you do not do the will of the Lord, who did for you as he spoke through his prophets, from Samuel the prophet onward, and the word of Ezekiel, and Enoch, and the reproof of Asaph.
verses.8: And he says: Guests will come, deceitful ones, who change their clothing, and there is no other law within them except eating and drinking, and they are adorned with gold and silver, and with every evil deed that does not please the Lord.
verses.9: And they are eager to run to eating and drinking; from the time they rise from their sleep, from morning until evening, they run to evil deeds, and for their feet there is no way of peace, but bloodshed and destruction are in their ways.
verses.10: And they do not know the way of peace, and there is no fear of the Lord before their eyes. They are a people of fornicators and deceivers, who have no taste and no faith, gluttons and eaters and drinkers and drunkards, and without law they commit adultery and fornication, and they shed blood, and theft, and plunder, and the seizure of the property of others by violence.
verses.11: And they are oppressors without law and without judgment, and there is no fear in their faces, for they do not fear the Lord who created them.
verses.12: And they are not ashamed before the face of a man who sees them, nor before the face of an elder, nor before the face of an old man. And when they hear of the wealth of the world, they forget what is theirs, which they do not guard with their eyes; and when they see with their eyes, it seems to them that they have spoken it with their mouths, for there is no fear of the Lord before their eyes.
verses.13: And their princes are devourers of sustenance, and what they speak in the morning they do not repeat in the evening, for they are liars, and there is no word of truth in their mouths.
verses.14: And their kings are eager for evil; they run, for they covet the houses of the poor and the needy, and they do not spare the stranger from the hand of the one who wrongs them.
verses.15: And because of this, kings shall not be oppressors, but they shall say to the stranger and to the sojourner.
verses.16: And they are bloodthirsty and violent, who drink blood, and they do not teach a child with his mother, nor a bird with her chicks, for deceit is all their way; what they have seen and learned, they forget what is theirs.
verses.17: And they do not teach the poor and the needy, but they love to gather for themselves, and they seize the property of others by violence, and everything they find they gather, so that they may store it up in their houses and rejoice in it.
verses.18: Woe to their souls, when the Lord seizes them in their death, because they did not keep their ordinances in their life; for they will perish quickly, like that which came out of the womb, which is not found after ten days and does not enter into its house.
verses.19: And likewise they will perish in a moment, in one instant; when the Lord visits them, they will perish in his time, for the Lord does not hasten to destroy, but he is patient, in case they should enter into repentance.
verses.20: And if they do not enter into repentance, the Lord will destroy them, like the former ones who were before them, who did not keep the commandment of the Lord in purity.
verses.21: And they are eaters of the flesh of men and drinkers of blood, and there is no fear of the Lord at any time, for they persist in violence and in running, from the time they rise from their sleep, and they do not rest from doing violence.
verses.22: For eating and drinking and running to evil and wickedness, so that they may destroy many souls upon the earth.
